edits.current: COMPOSITE VALUE - construction rule. Cumulative service with the employer expressed in DAYS on the Colombian commercial-year convention fixed by Technical Annex s.8.3.1: 1 year = 360 days, 1 month = 30 days. The annex's own worked example is 5 years + 3 months + 18 days = (5 x 360) + (3 x 30) + 18 = 1908.00. Sub-fields: [years x 360] + [months x 30] + [odd days]. PERSISTENCE: recomputed every month from FechaIngreso (NIE002) to the settlement end; it is cumulative service, NOT days worked in the period (that is DiasTrabajados, NIE069).
